query:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS max_snap
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
household_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region,
        d.head_of_household_id,
        COUNT(d.id) AS household_size
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON d.id = hl.id
    JOIN estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp ON d.id = hp.id
    JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON hp.snapshot = ls.max_snap
    WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE
    GROUP BY hl.region, d.head_of_household_id
)
SELECT 
    region AS المنطقة,
    ROUND(AVG(household_size), 2) AS متوسط_عدد_أفراد_الأسرة
FROM household_counts
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY متوسط_عدد_أفراد_الأسرة DESC LIMIT 1200
